limitations: Prototype only: live transform/visibility/material/fade/light lifecycle updates are not implemented.
Ranked over-budget grouping is a negative control; it fails after energy-only changes even though the initial frozen twelve-light case matches.
The default guard retains original meshes whenever any complete per-type light set exceeds the budget, and checks the merged AABB as well as each member.
Compatibility still has up to three changed pixels without shadows and nine with shadows on bz13h; some original/restored controls also vary. This is not universal pixel identity.
Forward+ retains 15-20 changed pixels and can add draws (898 to 907 with twelve lights); do not enable this manual grouping there.
Recorded build time is one-time snapshot/planning/construction, not per-frame submission time or a gameplay FPS result.
Initial wider-map reports were invalidated by grass streaming and CPU water updates. Final cases wait for grass queues/jobs, disable map processing, then freeze all existing shader TIME uses.
Four-light limit was tested in the desktop exported renderer, not on Android/web hardware.
Failed first four-light trial lacked the native sidecar; it was corrected before recorded cases.
